title: Human Computer Interaction: Main Exam, 16 August 2021
department: Department of Information Technology / enterprise Computing
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: In order to produce computer systems with good usability, developers must achieve specific goals of human computer interaction (HCI). List down the four goals of HCI.
Using an example, describe the meaning of visibility and affordance and state how each can be achieved in a system.
Differentiate the concept of the Gulf of Evaluation from the concept of the Gulf of Execution in HCI.
Describe the idea of link affordance with respect to a website.
Outline the different functions of how icons can be used in interfaces.
When simple issues in software require labels or instructions, the design is bad. Explain the actions afforded by common user interface controls.
Differentiate between structural models and functional models in HCI.
Illustrate which model would be applied greatly by users of a computer system.

An understanding of the way humans perceive visual information is important in the design of visual displays in computer systems. With an example for each, differentiate between constructivist and ecological theories of perception in a computer system.

Closely related to mental models in HCI is the idea of gulfs between the interface of a system and the users. Illustrate how both the users and the designers can overcome both the Gulf of Evaluation and the Gulf of Execution in computer systems.
With examples, explain how a good design can make use of icons in interfaces, stating the specific function of an icon in each case.
The desktop metaphor has been used successfully in operating systems. State the metaphor(s) used in the following types of applications and, in each, suggest the familiar knowledge.
Data storage
Spreadsheets
The web
Graphics packages
Media players
Suggest five guidelines which can be used to improve affordance on text links and on graphical links found on a website.
With a relevant illustration, explain the meaning of the term graphical user interface (GUI) and justify why GUI is also known as WIMP.
Windowing systems have a fixed generic language for their imaging model. Elaborate on this statement.
Describe five rules/guidelines used to ensure that commands are meaningful to users of application software. For each guideline, use a relevant example from Microsoft application software.
When simple issues in software require labels or instructions, the design is bad. Explain the actions afforded by common user interface controls.
Suggest guidelines on how to ensure that commands in computer systems are meaningful.
Explain the concept of meaningfulness with respect to a computer system.
Describe four factors which determine the meaningfulness of items in interfaces which use commands and interfaces which use icons.
